steps.text: 9:37 A.M. \ Overcast
Near the City Defense Force Main Command Tower, Auchterigg District of Londinium

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All Rhodes Island Spec Ops Team Amiya hands, as per our plan, we will work with the Self-Salvation Corps and launch an ambush on the Londinium Defense Force's command tower.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have only one objective: obtain the message logs from the defense system about the Sarkaz supply line.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These messages will determine the success or failure of our entire Londinium operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that's... even if we most likely can no longer stop Theresis from declaring war on the dukes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But if we get our hands on this information, we'll have a chance to slow the pace of the war and reduce the sacrifices that come with it to a minimum.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We may have come well-prepared, but we need to expect the unexpected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All of us know in our hearts that, in the coming war, each battle will be more difficult than the last.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But we came all this way for the same, unshakable goal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's time to keep going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

options: Amiya, we have another emergency on our hands.
Another Sarkaz King might appear on the battlefield.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I know you're worried about me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't say for sure that I'm ready... but ever since we left Sudean, I've been thinking what it will be like to see her again.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If she stands opposite us, I want to know why. I want to feel... everything that she feels.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But just as I told the operators, I will never forget why we came here in the first place.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand very well that the future of the Sarkaz and the whole world that Theresa hoped for is slipping further and further away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's exactly the future that I, Dr. Kal'tsit, and all the operators who came to Londinium with us hope for.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For that, we are prepared to face anything, and we will fight each battle like it is our last.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, Doctor. Let's go.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The Sarkaz army has been quick to mobilize lately.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, Lt. Colonel.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Everyone has been saying... saying...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Saying what?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: They've been saying that the Sarkaz are going to strike the dukes' forces soon. When that happens, they will throw us onto the battlefield as their cannon fodder.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: My apologies, Lt. Colonel. I've spoken out of turn.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: No, I don't blame you.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We all trust you, sir. We all know how difficult it is to negotiate with the Sarkaz... but you've done it.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: All these years, it was you who kept us safe.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Even the time the Duke of Stafford revolted. If it wasn't for how accurate your judgment was, I would've been killed long ago by the rebels' cannonfire!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: You saved us time and again, and you protected this city from all sorts of conspiracies.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: As long as you're behind the decision, not one of us will question it.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: ...I know that.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: It's precisely because I know that...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What's that sound in the streets down there?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: It's the cargo track... They must be transporting construction material for the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: On guard!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: —Good morning.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Wait, where did all these men come from?

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: Save your breath, unless you are willing to cough up the coin.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Mercenaries... Who sent you? Which duke?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We don't know any dukes, and they certainly wouldn't know us.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Are... Are you the rebels?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We're the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Self-... Salvation Corps...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You know what this is about.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You should've been the ones fighting the Sarkaz, but you chose to raise the white flag. That left us no choice but to rise up ourselves.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Hold your ground! Don't let them into the tower!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Soldier.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: You're Victorian, aren't you?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: ...I am.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Twenty thousand Defense Forces men are stationed across the city.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Aside from those who were killed or captured, every last one of them is bound to the land they stand on by the same order, becoming an accessory to Sarkaz crimes.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There is no way you are not aware that the Sarkaz will soon be launching a war on all of Victoria.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: When that time comes, will you still stand with the Sarkaz against your own friends and family?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Perhaps all you want is to survive. But you are not Sarkaz. You will never truly earn their trust. Once the war begins in earnest, they could abandon you at any moment.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I can see your hesitation. In the end, you are only footmen. It is the man who gives your orders, not you, who we must confront.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: So, stand aside.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Do not give ground. Not one of you! We will hold the line here!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We are soldiers. We trust our commander.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: We must follow our orders.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Lt. Colonel! The enemy is attacking the defensive line!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: No idea where or how they came, all of a sudden. Even if they snuck along the cargo track and managed to slip past the Sarkaz checkpoints on the surface, there's no way they could've gotten through the tower's surveillance system.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Unless someone hacked the system and took down all the sentinels within a very short period of time...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: But... That's impossible!

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I... er!
Nothing is impossible.
A shadow flies toward him.
He can smell the scent of death. Unlike the sense of viscous suffocation he felt before the Sanguinarch of Vampires, he knows he will die a quick and relatively painless death.
Which is why he chose not to pointlessly attempt a dodge.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Nngh—!
Out of my way!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So you've come after all.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Ascalon... How long has it been?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Nine days ago, when you barged into Westhaleg, were you also prepared to brandish the weapon the General bestowed upon you directly at him, as you are doing now?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: And, unlike you...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I will not hesitate.
